examples.trans: Let's fire him and put you in his place.

meanings.note: Много дел = a lot to do.

examples.trans: I have a lot to do.

examples.text: Мне некогда об этом думать. Слишком много дел.
examples.trans: I have no time to think about that. There's too much to do.

meanings.note: plural only: there is no singular in everyday use

examples.trans: The money is on the table.

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: To run for a second term.

examples.trans: He is running for a second term.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

examples.text: Я вам искренне сочувствую, но мне пора работать.
examples.trans: I sincerely feel for you, but it is time for me to work.

examples.text: Мы искренне благодарим вас за помощь.
examples.trans: We sincerely thank you for your help.

examples.text: Марина Сергеевна, я вам искренне сочувствую.
examples.trans: Marina Sergeyevna, I sincerely sympathize with you.

meanings.note: in exclamations: какой грязный! = how dirty!

examples.text: Смотрите, какой у нас грязный унитаз!
examples.trans: Look, how dirty our toilet is!
I try very hard to write nicely.

examples.text: Вот теперь кусочки нарезаны красиво и аккуратно.
examples.trans: Now the pieces are cut beautifully and neatly.

meanings.note: наш, наша, наше, наши; agrees with the noun

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

examples.text: Ну что, довольна? Теперь новую работу искать.
examples.trans: Well, happy now? Now I have to look for a new job.

meanings.note: + prepositional; об before a vowel: об этом

examples.text: Мне некогда об этом думать. Слишком много дел.

examples.text: Вот это дело! Потом обратно бесплатно отвезу.
examples.trans: Now we're talking! Afterwards I'll drive you back for free.

examples.trans: This is a contract for the purchase of construction equipment.

meanings.en: to please, to be to someone's liking
meanings.note: + dative: тебе понравится = you'll like it

examples.trans: Don't be afraid, you'll like it.

examples.text: А придётся! Не бойся, тебе понравится.
examples.trans: Well, you'll have to! Don't be afraid, you'll like it.

meanings.en: to do some work, to work for a bit

examples.trans: I need to do a bit of work.
I'll do some work at home.
I need to do a bit of work.

послать.gloss: to send; (colloquial) to tell someone where to go

meanings.en: to tell someone to get lost

examples.text: А если подойдёт Дима, то послать его подальше.
examples.trans: And if Dima comes over, tell him to get lost.

examples.text: Он просто послал меня обратно работать.
examples.trans: He just sent me back to work.

meanings.note: у меня есть предложение = I have an offer

examples.trans: It's a good offer, of course.

examples.text: Значит, предложение такое. Ты мне говоришь, где твои сорок миллионов.
examples.trans: So, here's the offer. You tell me where your forty million is.
But you were offered a job.

examples.text: Тебе же предложили работу. Что, плохая работа?
examples.trans: But you were offered a job. What, is it a bad job?

представить.gloss: to imagine, to picture; to introduce

examples.text: Представь: тебе сорок лет, жена красавица.
examples.trans: Imagine: you're forty, with a beautiful wife.
Allow me to introduce my friend to you.

examples.text: Представь: тебе сорок лет, жена красавица, дети, бизнес. А тебя все зовут врунишкой!
examples.trans: Imagine: you're forty, with a beautiful wife, children, a business. And everyone still calls you a little liar!

meanings.note: + dative of the buyer: 'продать соседке' = to sell to the neighbour

examples.trans: I'll sell it to the neighbour.

examples.text: Ну, как знаешь. Продам его Клавдии Викторовне.
examples.trans: Well, suit yourself. I'll sell it to Klavdia Viktorovna.

examples.text: Мы просто не хотели вас беспокоить. Всё отменим!
examples.trans: We just didn't want to bother you. We'll cancel it all!

meanings.note: работать + instrumental = to work as: работать мэром

examples.text: Я уже четыре года работаю мэром.
examples.trans: I've been working as mayor for four years now.

meanings.note: Dining establishment. Borrowed from French 'restaurant' (from 'restaurer', to restore strength with rich broth); entered Russian in the early 19th century.

examples.text: Кстати, звонили из итальянского ресторана. Дарят папе романтический ужин на двоих.
examples.trans: By the way, they called from the Italian restaurant. They're giving Dad a romantic dinner for two.

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

examples.trans: Share it all equally with everyone, understand?

examples.text: Я забрала из сейфа твой сотейник.

meanings.note: Borrowed via French/German from Medieval Latin 'situatio' (position, state of affairs, from 'situs').

examples.trans: This is a very complicated situation.

examples.text: Да никуда я не пряталась! Я контролировала ситуацию.
examples.trans: I wasn't hiding anywhere! I was controlling the situation.
